title: strychnos innocua subsp. burtonii
intro: Strychnos innocua subsp. burtonii, commonly known as the African berry strychnine tree, is a plant species in the family Loganiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in African medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Strychnos innocua subsp. burtonii include anti-hypertensive, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential of this plant in providing health benefits and its therapeutic applications.
